info.name: Billings — YAKAP Tranches
info.description:
# YAKAP period billing API

Import this Collection v2.1 into Postman. Set `base_url`, `api_key`, `token`, and `requester` for your environment. Credential variables are intentionally blank.

- UAT: https://zuat-accounting-back.myt-emr.com
- Production: https://accounting-back.myt-emr.com

Default branch is 2 (Oakridge), year 2025, month 12. Adjust these to the actual period before sending requests. All saved response examples are illustrative and are not captured production data. Bills use company 3210, gross amounts, existing approval thresholds, and existing GL/JE/collection behavior.

The two preview requests are read-only. The two creation examples call the same POST endpoint with different tranche_number values. No API calls were executed to generate this document. No automatic workflow scripts are included.

Successful responses are plain JSON objects, without an extra data/status wrapper. Validation failures use status/error/messages.error_messages. Source failures use the existing server-error response (500), never silently zero counts. Preview date eligibility changes with current Asia/Manila time. Existing prior-year carryover and submission-deadline rules are outside this version.

request.description:
## Monthly FPE billing preview

Authentication: `API-KEY` header plus `token` and `requester` query/form fields. Permissions follow existing billing transaction-read/create permissions. All examples are illustrative, not captured from production.

Branch IDs: 1 Mobile, 2 Oakridge, 3 Mactan, 4 Consolacion, 7 Mantlewood. `year` must be an integer from 1900 through 9998. Each endpoint handles one branch; no branchless union or pagination parameters are used.

Returns all 12 months. `fpe_count` counts unique active patients, assigned to the month of their earliest active FPE **within this year**. Repeated FPE records do not increase the annual cohort. Amount = FPE count × ₱680.

Each month returns `is_completed`, `is_billed`, `can_bill`, and nullable `billing` (saved billing reference and snapshot). A month is complete from the first day of its following month, Asia/Manila. Zero-value or already billed months cannot be created.

`totals` has `total`, `billed`, `unbilled`, and `completed_unbilled`; each contains live `fpe_count` and `calculated_amount`. Root `billed_amount` sums actual saved amounts. Live source changes can make calculated amounts differ from saved snapshots; existing bills are not silently recalculated.

response.name: Illustrative — 12 months with billed and unbilled periods

request.description:
## Annual performance billing preview

Authentication: `API-KEY` header plus `token` and `requester` query/form fields. Permissions follow existing billing transaction-read/create permissions. All examples are illustrative, not captured from production.

Branch IDs: 1 Mobile, 2 Oakridge, 3 Mactan, 4 Consolacion, 7 Mantlewood. `year` must be an integer from 1900 through 9998. Each endpoint handles one branch; no branchless union or pagination parameters are used.

The denominator is the unique active FPE cohort for the year. Annual KPIs count unique beneficiaries within that cohort: active ekonsulta assessments, active laboratory results (no is_sent requirement), and therapeutic prescriptions linked to active ekonsulta assessments and active master items. Antibiotics use is_antibiotic=1; NCD uses is_antibiotic=0 with a non-null philhealth_medicine_type. Therapeutic records indicate prescriptions, not verified dispensing.

Targets/weights: consultation 1/0.30; laboratory 0.50/0.30; antibiotic 0.15/0.10; NCD 0.20/0.30. For each KPI: actual_score = round(count/FPE, 2); computation = round(min(actual_score/target, 1), 2); resultant_score = round(computation×weight, 2). All rounding is half up. Sum resultant scores, then gross amount = round(FPE×performance_factor×₱1,020, 2). Zero FPE gives zero scores/amount.

An annual period is complete from January 1 of the next year, Asia/Manila. Previews remain available for unfinished years; `can_bill` is false. The sample shows 14,850 FPEs and 8,000/3,000/2,000/1,500 KPI beneficiaries producing 52% and ₱7,876,440. `billing` is null when unbilled; otherwise it contains the immutable saved snapshot. `billed_amount` is the saved gross amount and `unbilled_amount` is zero when billed.

request.description:
## Create one YAKAP billing period

Authentication: `API-KEY` header plus `token` and `requester` query/form fields. Permissions follow existing billing transaction-read/create permissions. All examples are illustrative, not captured from production.

Branch IDs: 1 Mobile, 2 Oakridge, 3 Mactan, 4 Consolacion, 7 Mantlewood. `year` must be an integer from 1900 through 9998. Each endpoint handles one branch; no branchless union or pagination parameters are used.

Required multipart text fields: token, requester, branch_id, year, tranche_number; month is additionally required for tranche 1 (1–12). For tranche 2 omit month (0 is also accepted). Do not set multipart Content-Type manually: Postman generates the boundary.

One successful request creates one master billing header and one aggregate entry, with saved calculation timestamp/version. Company and charge-to are fixed to **3210 PHILHEALTH - YAKAP**, not 2032. No `entries` or financial total is needed; the server calculates gross amounts. If company_id/charge_to/charge_to_id or grand_total/amount/balance/subtotal/total_amount are supplied, conflicting values are rejected. Withholding is applied by existing collection workflows.

Completion rules apply in Asia/Manila: tranche 1 after month-end, tranche 2 after year-end. The locked period registry prevents concurrent duplicate active bills. Pending, approved, open, and closed bills reserve the period. Cancellation/deletion permits replacement while retaining history. Unfinished, already billed, or zero-value periods are rejected.

Amounts ≥₱50,000 are pending; lower amounts are automatically approved with creator/time recorded. The response includes IDs, grand_total, and the pre-creation calculation snapshot; snapshot is_billed=false/can_bill=true describes the calculation before insertion. Subsequent previews show the period as billed. Generic billing creation cannot create YAKAP tranches. Existing invoice metadata updates, approvals, and collections remain available; financial/period edits require cancellation and recreation.

Creation requests write accounting records when sent. This collection contains saved examples only and does not auto-run requests or depend on response scripts.

formdata.description: Optional real YYYY-MM-DD date; defaults to creation date in Asia/Manila.
Optional, at most 64 characters; empty becomes null. Must respect the existing unique invoice number constraint.
Optional real YYYY-MM-DD date; empty becomes null.

Completion rules apply in Asia/Manila: tranche 1 after month-end, tranche 2 after year-end. The locked period registry prevents concurrent duplicate active bills. Subsequent previews show the period as billed. Generic billing creation cannot create YAKAP tranches. Existing invoice metadata updates, approvals, and collections remain available; financial/period edits require cancellation and recreation.
